title: UP Scholarship Online Form 2024 Last Date : 31/12/2024
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://scholarship.up.gov.in
2. Select Fresh / Renewal application
3. Login with registration details
4. Fill form, upload income & caste certificates
5. Submit before 31 December 2024 (as notified for that cycle)
shortDescription: UP Scholarship Online Form 2024 – last date 31 Dec 2024 (cycle). Apply/renew on scholarship.up.gov.in.
content:
The UP Scholarship portal accepts Pre-Matric and Post-Matric applications for eligible students.

For the 2024 cycle, last date was notified as 31 December 2024. Students need Aadhaar-seeded bank account, income certificate, caste certificate (if applicable) and institution verification. For current year check the portal again.
